title: Mengzi variant collation, English drafts batch 05

units.hanzi_span: 孟子曰：“人之忌，在好為人師。”
units.source_chinese: 孟子曰：「人之患，在好為人師。」
units.source_english: Mencius said, 'The evil of men is that they like to be teachers of others.'
units.legge_ref: Mencius, Book IV, Part I, CHAP. 23
units.variant_note: 忌 versus 患; classical meaning 'cacat' supports 患.

units.hanzi_span: 孟子謂樂正子曰：“子之從於子敖來，徒哺啜也。我不意子學古之道，而以哺啜也。”
units.source_chinese: 孟子謂樂正子曰：「子之從於子敖來，徒餔啜也。我不意子學古之道而以餔啜也。」
units.source_english: Mencius, addressing the disciple Yue Zheng, said to him, 'Your coming here in the train of Zi Ao was only because of the food and the drink. I could not have thought that you, having learned the doctrine of the ancients, would have acted with a view to eating and drinking.'
units.legge_ref: Mencius, Book IV, Part I, CHAP. 25
units.variant_note: 哺 versus 餔 twice; 餔啜 is attested in classical commentary.

units.hanzi_span: 孟子曰：“言無實，不祥。不祥之實，蔽賢者當之。”
units.source_chinese: 孟子曰：「言無實，不詳。不詳之實，蔽賢者當之。」
units.source_english: Mencius said, 'Words which are not true are inauspicious, and the words which are most truly obnoxious to the name of inauspicious, are those which throw into the shade men of talents and virtue.'
units.legge_ref: Mencius, Book IV, Part II, CHAP. 17
units.variant_note: 祥 versus 詳 twice; 'inauspicious' in English and Indonesian favors 祥.

excluded.reason: Zhu Xi commentary 林氏曰 and 愚謂 embedded within core Mengzi passage; requires separate source/Ruby correction before full Legge alignment.
